insurer: IFFCO TOKIO General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.display: 1.5% of SI/day (Class A) or 1.25% (others); No cap if SI ≥ ₹7L
room_rent.note: For SI ≥ ₹7L (excl. critical illness SI), room rent is at actuals. For SI < ₹7L, 1.5% of SI/day in Class A cities, 1.25% elsewhere. Cap can be removed for SI < ₹7L on payment of 6% additional premium.

icu.display: 2.5% of SI/day (Class A) or 2% (others); No cap if SI ≥ ₹7L
icu.note: For SI ≥ ₹7L, ICU at actuals. For SI < ₹7L, 2.5% of SI/day in Class A cities, 2% elsewhere. Cap removable via optional add-on.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay in base plan. Co-pay of 10%, 20% or 25% is an optional extension chosen at inception; once opted, cannot be removed during policy period.

sub_limits.display: Domiciliary capped at 20% of SI; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation sub-limit: 20% of SI. Modern treatments (robotic surgery etc.): 50% of SI. No disease-wise monetary sub-limits otherwise.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (cataract, hernia, knee replacement etc.); 12 months (tonsils, varicose veins etc.)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month list: tonsillitis, tympanoplasty, fistula, piles, varicose veins, ligament tears, carcinoma. 24-month list: cataract, BPH, hernia, hydrocele, sinusitis, gallstones, IVD disorders, knee/joint replacement, chronic renal failure, fibroids, benign growths.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of base SI (25% yr1, 10%/yr thereafter)
cumulative_bonus.note: CB accrues at 25% of basic SI after first claim-free year, then 10% per subsequent claim-free year, max 100% of basic SI. Reduces at accrual rate on a claim. Alternatively, insured may opt for 5% No Claim Discount on premium instead of CB.

restoration.display: Once per claim, up to full basic SI; charged from 2nd reinstatement
restoration.note: Basic SI reinstated to extent of claim paid after each claim. First reinstatement is free; subsequent reinstatements charged pro-rata premium. Reinstated SI not available for same illness relapse within 45 days, chronic critical illnesses, domiciliary hospitalisation, or cumulative bonus. Applies to SI ≥ ₹3L.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to hospitalisation for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (383 listed in Annexure C)
day_care.note: Specific list of 383 day-care procedures covered. List is dynamic and updated on website.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered subject to 20% of SI aggregate sub-limit. Several diseases excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation including pre- and post-hospitalisation covered up to the sum insured per policy period.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered subject to insured's sub-limits and SI. Donor room rent limited to 50% of insured's room rent entitlement. Ambulance, pre/post-hosp and daily allowance not payable for donor.

ambulance.display: 1% of SI or ₹2,500, whichever is lower, per hospitalisation
ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges covered as additional benefit subject to lower of 1% of SI or ₹2,500 per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered (robotic surgery, oral chemo, deep brain stimulation, HIFU, etc.) up to 50% of SI per policy period.

consumables.note: Consumables such as gloves, masks, syringes etc. are listed as non-payable items in Annexure A List I. No optional rider for consumables mentioned.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only; claims payable in Indian currency only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for renewal and non-monthly instalments; 15 days for monthly instalments. Coverage not available during grace period after policy expiry.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document at inception only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers permitted with continuity of waiting periods and accrued benefits.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, sterility/IVF, external congenital diseases, acupuncture/acupressure, intra-articular injections, OPD-only procedures converted to IP, adventure sports (non-professional too), 90-day wait for diabetes/hypertension complications
optional_riders: Higher SI for Critical Illness (indemnity), No-limit Room Rent/ICU add-on (6% extra premium), Co-payment option (10%/20%/25%)
